svg.title: Teach Anything architecture
svg.desc: A Next.js app. Pages reach stored state only through the session service, which hands the learning history to a pure, seeded learning engine built on FSRS-6 memory and Bayesian mastery estimates, and gets back the next activity and due dates. State lives in Postgres with pgvector, row-level security, and an append-only mastery log; a database trigger refuses to serve a question without a grounded source. Code exercises run in QuickJS or a network-less Docker sandbox. Every model call goes through one AI gateway to the provider the learner configures, and a course worker builds courses behind human review gates.
